label: Rewind
depicts: Rounded square rewind frame with a top left arrow and the number five inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants a rewind timer inside a rounded square frame marked five.
avoid_when: Do not use for the circular rewind family when the square frame is the visible cue.

label: Rewind
depicts: Rounded square rewind frame with a top left arrow and the number ten inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants the square framed rewind timer labeled ten.
avoid_when: Do not use for the other square rewind counts when the number ten is the key cue.

label: Rewind
depicts: Rounded square rewind frame with a top left arrow and the number fifteen inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants the square rewind timer variant labeled fifteen.
avoid_when: Do not use for the five ten or thirty square timers when fifteen is the visible number.

label: Rewind
depicts: Rounded square rewind frame with a top left arrow and the number thirty inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants the largest count version in the square rewind family.
avoid_when: Do not use for the lower square rewind counts when the number thirty should stay visible.

label: Forward
depicts: Right hooked return arrow with a straight lower line and rounded outer bend
use_when: Use when the interface wants a plain forward or return arrow instead of a rewind timer.
avoid_when: Do not use for square countdown rewind icons when the icon should stay as one simple arrow.
